description: This file contains selector functions for managing and retrieving channel sidebar data in a Mattermost web application, including categories, unread channels, and UI state.

methods.name: isUnreadFilterEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the unread filter is enabled in the channel sidebar, considering user preferences.

methods.name: getCategoriesForCurrentTeam
methods.description: Retrieves channel categories for the current team, memoized for performance.

methods.name: getAutoSortedCategoryIds
methods.description: Gets IDs of categories that are sorted alphabetically or by recency.

methods.name: getChannelsByCategoryForCurrentTeam
methods.description: Retrieves channels grouped by category for the current team, memoized.

methods.name: getUnreadChannelIdsSet
methods.description: Creates a set of unread channel IDs for quick lookup.

methods.name: getChannelsInCategoryOrder
methods.description: Returns channels in the order they appear in the sidebar, excluding unread channels in the Unreads category.

methods.name: getUnreadChannels
methods.description: Returns all unread channels, sorted by recency and mentions, for display when the unread filter is active.

methods.name: getDisplayedChannels
methods.description: Returns channels currently visible in the sidebar, considering unread filter and category collapse.

methods.name: makeGetFilteredChannelIdsForCategory
methods.description: Creates a selector to get visible channel IDs for a category, excluding unread channels if Unreads category is active.

methods.name: makeGetUnreadIdsForCategory
methods.description: Creates a selector to get unread channel IDs for a category, excluding unread channels if Unreads category is active.

methods.name: getDraggingState
methods.description: Retrieves the current dragging state of the channel sidebar.

methods.name: isChannelSelected
methods.description: Checks if a specific channel is selected in the sidebar.
